scope: Resident fixed-basis material sweeps through generic FEM solve and electrostatic energy operators

implementation.numeric_path: native copy/scale/axpy into persistent CSR and RHS; finite validation and synchronization before validity publication
implementation.preconditioner: retains prepared symmetric AMG for PCG; caller preserves SPD/HPD and decides when to refresh
implementation.constraints: base contains identity rows; material delta has zero constrained rows; RHS bases include matching Dirichlet lifting

physical_cases.analytic_reference: two dielectrics in series, interface x=0.5; piecewise-linear potential

failure_cases: failed device copy invalidates system and warm start
energy failure disables evaluation until full replacement
terminal synchronization error requires context recreation
limitations: Host geometry, initial material bases and AMG setup remain. CPU assembly inside tests supplies independent reference only for combination runs.
Only affine fixed-pattern material variation is represented; arbitrary material callbacks, changing geometry and constraints require new lowering or setup.
New combination API physically validated for f64 electrostatic forward action; other scalar/action combinations need explicit coverage.
No measured speedup or arbitrary-contrast lagged-AMG convergence claim.
